notes: 1.8.9 now runs on Java 17, which Auoris downloads by itself.
If one of your own mods needs Java 8, Auoris starts the game on Java 8 instead and remembers that until your mods change.
1.7.10, 1.12.2 and Fabric now have much more of 1.8.9: the main menu account switcher, the resource pack browser with folders and search, many more modules, and on 1.7.10 emotes and cosmetics too.
Resource packs you pick from a folder now stay picked after a restart, Done on the pack screen no longer reloads packs that didn't change, and the folder pack counts are right.
You can now show your own pet in first person (Settings > Nametags & pet), and Fly boost also works when a server gives you /fly.
The Privacy Policy now lists where the launcher downloads Minecraft, its mod loaders and Java from.
Hits you time right as the other player can be hurt again now count for the Hit sound, the combo counter, Nametags health and the hit log; before, many real hits were missed.
The instant Hit sound now plays once for each hit that can land instead of on every click.
Your held item now shakes with the camera when you take damage, at every Hurt camera amount.
Minecraft now quits properly when its window is closed by Task Manager or another program, instead of running on without a window.
Emotes no longer use up more graphics memory each time they play, and the HUD's TPS now shows how fast the server really runs.
The Bow draw HUD element has been removed; Bow sync stays.
If you send crash reports, Minecraft crashes are now included too, and Auoris tells you when Java itself crashed, which is often a graphics driver problem.
New replies, notifications and dialogs no longer stay invisible while Auoris is in the background, and signing in is faster.
On 1.7.10 and Fabric, the HUD's TPS is fixed and more settings now match 1.8.9.

Fixed Invalid session when joining a server after playing for a while: Auoris now gives the game a fresh Minecraft sign-in before it runs out, and if a server still turns it down, the game gets a new one from the Auoris app and joins that server again by itself.
An offline account that tries to join a server that needs a Microsoft account now says so, instead of Invalid session.
Bow sync (Settings > General, on by default): your bow now looks fully drawn exactly when the shot is full power and a critical hit, at the same moment the Bow draw HUD shows FULL.

Changing worlds, like a delayed teleport, no longer closes the chat you are typing in: it opens again with your text once the new world has loaded (Chat tweaks > Keep your chat open when you change worlds).
Armor follows your emotes again instead of staying in the normal pose.
Other players see your emotes again even when their app loses its live connection.
Hide foliage can no longer hide leaves.
In the launcher, the Shop now opens from the Shop card on the Play tab.
Fixed a blank 404 page that could show after an update until Auoris was restarted.
New Bow draw on your HUD: while you draw a bow it shows the shot's power, and a green FULL once the arrow will be full power and critical.
The bow looks fully drawn a little before that, so wait for FULL.
New Bow release fix in Settings > General (on by default): letting go of right click and pressing it again quickly while drawing a bow now always shoots, instead of the bow sometimes staying drawn.
The regen timer now restarts at 10 minutes when a player uses another Totem Of Regeneration while the first one is still running.
Armor switch: when your armor gets low and no fresh set is left in your inventory, a notification and a beep tell you (Armor switch > Notify when no fresh set is left).
The armor switch no longer stops halfway when the server refuses a click during a fight: it puts the item on your cursor back and finishes the swap.
While the armor switch runs, mouse clicks and the hotbar and drop keys in your inventory wait, so nothing gets thrown out.
Hold the player list key (Tab) and then open chat to keep the player list on screen while you type (Chat tweaks, on by default).
The creative inventory search box lines up with the inventory again when Hide potion effects is on.
New Pack Icons and Descriptions toggles on the Resource Packs screen and in Settings > General.
In the Wave, Dance, Cheer and Headbang emotes a raised arm now swings out to the side instead of through your head.
New in Settings > General: Mouse delay fix (on by default) makes your clicks hit what the crosshair is on while you turn.
Hit delay fix (off by default) removes 1.8's half-second pause after a missed click; some servers may not allow it.

The gapple regen timer now shows past Max distance (through walls only within 64 blocks, like name tags), stays right when players leave and come back, and follows PikaNetwork's Totem Of Regeneration.
A golden apple eaten during a longer regen no longer cuts the timer short.
Translated chat keeps the line's own colours: the message is translated in place with a clickable (translated) after it.
Clicking (translated) now translates only your next message, !t cancels it, and the new Translate all my messages to setting translates everything you send.
Security fixes: 1.7.10 only follows web links for server resource packs, and the Microsoft sign-in page shows its error text safely.
The privacy policy now covers the in-game chat translator.
Armor switch: if the server closes your inventory in the middle of a switch (some servers do when a special armor piece comes off), it opens it again and finishes the set.
The gapple regen timer on nametags keeps counting while you're tabbed out.
Gaming boost no longer turns itself off when Auoris Mind runs a routine.
Your settings are no longer reset if the settings file can't be read for a moment.
Updates are found within a minute, and the restart is a few seconds quicker.
A new Minecraft skin shows in the launcher within seconds.
On the Shop card, Alex's raised hand no longer goes through her head.
The Play tab has a Shop card where Alex shows off wings, hats and pets while playing the Wave, Dance and Cheer emotes.
Quick play fills its row with your servers and ends with an Add server tile.
The game window's title now starts with Minecraft and its version, so clip recording apps spot the game again.
You can now try Auoris in your browser at auoris.org/demo before you download it.
Auoris Mind is the AI assistant as its own app, so Auoris itself is your Minecraft launcher and friends: open it with the Mind button or add it in Setup.
A new Shop in the launcher: wings, hats and pets now come from the Shop, which isn't taking payments yet.
Auoris Plus now includes the Auoris Moon, Aurora Wave and Nether Portal capes, Auoris Wings, the Jewelled Crown, and the Axolotl and Bee pets.
Tool skins are gone.
Every server in your list shows its players online and ping.
Every on/off option is now a switch, the memory slider fills as you drag it, and the Servers and Mods tabs have icon buttons and cleaner cards.
The Servers tab can add, edit and remove servers, and every Minecraft version sees the change.
Pick a background behind your skin on the Play tab, where your skin now stands in a relaxed pose, breathes and holds your sword skin.
A Notifications box on the Play tab shows friend requests and new messages, with a Go to messages button.
Cosmetics has one big 3D preview where wings and hats fit and you hold your tool, showing your own skin or Minecraft's real Steve.
Fly boost now only works while you fly in creative, so a server's /fly is never boosted.
The launcher's minimize, maximize and close buttons match the rest of the design.
A new Minecraft launcher screen in the app: tabs, a big skin, one Launch button with a version switch, Quick play with your server icons, friends and news.
The Auoris client now runs on 1.21.11 and 26.3 with the Auoris menu, HUD editor, cosmetics and many of its modules, and 1.7.10 gets the same menu and HUD.
FPS boost can keep item models on the graphics card (on by default for new settings), which helps a lot near other players.
New settings: more crosshair shapes, zoom speed and zoom per scroll notch, sprint text styles, brackets and value colours for HUD text.
Cleaner menus and HUD editor, and the default HUD spots no longer overlap.
Fixes: a key combo no longer stops the plain key from working; servers can no longer check for files on your PC through a resource pack link; a macro Hit step only hits what you look at.
The Fabric versions no longer need WalksyLib.
Chat has a search box and a scroll bar, chat is saved to log files on your computer (a Chat tweaks setting), and taking a screenshot no longer jumps the chat to the bottom.
Replay clips now include the game's own sound, never your microphone or other programs; Game sound in the replay buffer settings turns it off.
Chat hotkeys and macros can use mouse buttons, and macros can now run when you press a key.
Simpler, calmer menus with the Auoris logo on the main menu.
Zooming out no longer leaves chunks missing until you move the mouse.
Nametags keep the gapple regen timer over a sneaking player in plain sight (walls still hide it).
The replay buffer makes far less memory garbage, for fewer stutters while it records.
The pack loading boost is now always on.
The Privacy Policy was updated.
The gapple regen timer over players no longer disappears when the server lags or a player is out of sight for a moment.

New Macros button in the Auoris menu: when a chat line matches or when you send a message, run steps such as sending a message or command, waiting, switching slot or holding movement keys, and each macro has an On / Off switch.
New Hitboxes module shows hit boxes for the entities you pick, in your own colour.
The replay buffer records up to 120 fps (60 by default) and has a new Ultra quality.
Data from a server can no longer freeze or crash the game, and most errors are now caught instead of closing Minecraft.
New HUD editor and HUD looks, streamer mode, community role badges, a faster first Minecraft install and a faster resource pack screen.
Fly boost now works with Always sprint, and Hide foliage hides every plant without holes to the sky.
The Privacy Policy and Terms were updated.
The Auoris logo now shows in front of Auoris players' names in the tab list.
Modern lever hitbox is now a switch in Settings > General.
Minecraft 1.7 to 1.12 now plays normal stereo sound, so audio software can no longer make it sound like fake 3D.
Your chat keeps its place when you have scrolled up and someone talks.
Translated chat now shows the original message in front of the translation.
Fixed an FPS drop with your inventory open and with hats and pets on screen.
The Privacy Policy was updated.
Hotkeys now run the moment you press the key, even straight after closing chat or a loading screen, and a key you were already holding no longer counts.
The game window title shows your Auoris version, build and the account you are on.
Right-clicking a chat message copies the whole message, and changing chat settings no longer wipes stacked chat messages.
Fly boost in Toggle sprint now works whenever you can fly, including a server's /fly, and keeps the server's own fly speed.
New Modern lever hitbox module (off by default) gives levers the smaller hitbox from newer Minecraft versions.
Signing out now removes your Minecraft presence right away, and the Minecraft account check only ever shows Mojang a hash.
The Privacy Policy and Terms were updated to match.
Fixed the half-second freeze every time you switch worlds or servers (Minecraft 1.8.9 to 1.16).
Opening Options or Video Settings no longer reloads your chunks when Performance mode is on.
Click the number next to any slider to type an exact value.
New settings: Block outline can fill the block, Time changer has a custom hour, and Toggle sneak can keep sneaking after menus.
Esc now removes a keybind in the Auoris settings, and removing the emote wheel key in Controls sticks.
The AI: /agents 8 sets how many helper agents it can run for one prompt (/agents auto resets it), it can read public web pages, and /remember adds a note it keeps for that folder.
Fixed the game freezing for several seconds each time you switched worlds or servers with Performance mode on (joining a server could even time out on Logging in).
Ask before disconnecting is now off by default (turn it on in Settings if you want it).

Fixes two problems in 1.9.1: the new main menu backgrounds were missing (the menu was plain dark and the picker could not show them), and Hide loading screen showed the dirt loading screen again when you switch worlds or servers.
Both work again.
New menu backgrounds: pick from 14 backgrounds with the button at the top right of the main menu (point at one to preview it), or add your own pictures.
New account switcher: every account shows its face, hovering one shows it in 3D with its cape, and you can drag accounts into any order, in game or in the app.
Streamer mode (Settings > Streamer mode) hides server addresses, your name, private messages and your skin, each with its own switch, and replaces the Stream-proof HUD.
Disconnect asks first on servers, so a misclick doesn't drop you out of a game.
Minecraft starts faster and stays hidden until its menu is ready, with no loading screens.
Hide loading screen also skips the dirt screen between worlds.
New RAM optimizer (Settings, off by default) frees memory other programs aren't using when your PC runs low.
Replay clips save as MP4 and get Watch and Open folder buttons.
Hurtcam is now a slider from no shake to vanilla.
The emote wheel key can no longer get stuck on none.
Dragging the skin preview in the app turns the skin.
Privacy Policy and Acceptable Use Policy updated.

Big FPS boost: chat and the scoreboard are drawn from a cached picture instead of letter by letter every frame, the game no longer checks for graphics errors twice every frame, and Performance mode turns off OptiFine's Smooth FPS.
Golden apples always register now: your client waits for the server to finish the eat (Gapple sync), and Armor switch no longer cancels eating.
New Discord rich presence: your Discord profile shows Playing Auoris Client with the server you're on and its icon (Settings > Discord).
Graphics and brightness settings you change no longer switch back by themselves.
The emote wheel key and other Auoris keybinds no longer reset.
Auto text waits half a second after you close chat, so a letter typed right after doesn't fire it.
Players with arrows in them no longer vanish for a moment.
The in-game translator and /ai work again for chat with symbols like ».
Scrolling while zoomed no longer delays your clicks.
Fixed the water crash ('Tesselating block in world') still happening right after joining a server next to a waterfall.
Fixed a crash on chunks with a lot of water ('Tesselating block in world').
Ground pets now stand on the blocks under them instead of hanging at the wrong height after you fly, climb or swim.
Fixed freezes on servers with NPCs (like Pika Network): broken scoreboard updates from the server no longer stall the game.
When the game does freeze for a moment, one line about it now goes into the game's log, to help track down stutters.
Updated Terms and Privacy Policy.
Fixed low FPS: FPS boost no longer limits your frame rate when Windows thinks the game isn't focused (second monitor, a second game window, overlays).
Fixed a small stutter every couple of seconds from the audio device check.
Fixed a coloured tint that could show up when a far-away mob was hit.
The Team window shows an example prompt.
Updated Privacy Policy.
Fixed Minecraft crashing at startup on some sound devices (newer OpenAL).
Your game now stays online for friends and other players even if you close the Auoris app.
Only one Auoris runs at a time; opening it again brings the same window back.
Auoris pauses its animations when it isn't focused, so it takes less from your FPS.
Account switching works with two game windows open.
Chat hotkeys can be edited.
Fixed garbled arrows and dashes in the mod.
Team mode knows your name and instructions and compares models through your linked accounts.
Smooth font in the Auoris menus (Settings > Menu look).
Cleaner mod menu: brighter descriptions, lined-up counts, smooth scrolling edges, no key hint.
Emotes and Cosmetics now live on their own hub tiles.
Screenshot buttons sit on the screenshot line.
Potion effects are hidden in the inventory by default.
Closing Auoris while Minecraft runs keeps it in the tray, and opening it again brings the same window back.
A clear message when the AI declines a request.
Screenshot buttons in chat (Copy, Open in Explorer, Delete).
New Chunk borders module.
Fly boost in Toggle sprint (creative).
1.7 Visuals: armour flashes red when hit.
Capes and wings move as you walk.
Redesigned pets.
Translated chat now sends only plain keyboard characters.
Search chats moved above Explore, and the empty member list no longer takes space in DMs.
Cosmetics: redesigned pets and hats, a new wings slot, reworked emotes with custom sounds.
Minecraft: a faster resource pack menu, the potion HUD in inventory order, and the Auoris mod now updates together with the app.
Security: Minecraft is protected against Log4Shell chat messages and runs on an up-to-date Java 8.
Minecraft ownership is checked without your sign-in token leaving the PC.
System health scan fixes, and a much smaller installer.

Minecraft client: new Settings tab (nametags, HUD, controls, menu look, backup and reset), see your own nametag in F5, update notes now wrap and scroll instead of being cut off, Inventory mod shows in the menu again, and many new module options.

App: a cleaner message bar (one upload button for files and images, Call is now at the top right, the prompt library moved to Settings > Prompts), Stop during compaction keeps your chat, connector programs shut down fully, queued /extra and /team wait for the current reply, plus more reliability fixes.
Security updates for bundled libraries.
